name: Wilhelm Frick
role: Nazi German interior minister (1933–1943) and Reich Protector of Bohemia and Moravia (1943–1945)
summary: Frick helped replace parliamentary and federal government with Nazi dictatorship. He directed racial legislation, including the exclusion of Jews from citizenship, and compulsory sterilization policy.

strong-leader.rationale: He helped concentrate governmental authority in Hitler’s leadership.

decide-locally.rationale: His ministry eliminated autonomous state and municipal government.

traditional-family.rationale: His 1934 broadcast tied national recovery to women’s return to family and motherhood.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: His education speech prescribed cultivating German language, history and national identity.

revolution-justified.rationale: He participated in the 1923 putsch, but in 1933 forbade further revolution after consolidating Nazi power.

one-party-rule.rationale: His published explanation identified Nazi Party policy with national policy.

democracy-best.rationale: He publicly described his parliamentary task as undermining parliament.

political-violence-never.rationale: He assisted political murderers’ escape and participated in the Hitler putsch.

ethnic-nation.rationale: He defended racial purification as a central state task.

duties-before-rights.rationale: His education speech subordinated individual development to national and state service.

conscription.rationale: He introduced and extended compulsory military service.

total-state.rationale: His 1933 order demanded exclusive state authority, including over interventions in business.

national-rebirth.rationale: His school program portrayed Nazi victory as national awakening after liberal decay.

territorial-expansion.rationale: He organized German administration in annexed territories.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: His Mother’s Day speech assigned women a distinctive national role through motherhood.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: He developed racial legislation that excluded Jews from public life.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: His sterilization law authorized compulsory operations for specified purported hereditary conditions.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: His education speech demanded prevention of marriages and reproduction across racial boundaries.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: His citizenship legislation withheld voting and officeholding rights from Jews.

population-transfer.rationale: He organized forced resettlement in occupied Poland.

separated-powers.rationale: He helped remove constitutional restraints and construct centralized dictatorship.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: He drafted the decree suspending civil rights after the Reichstag fire.

party-controls-media.rationale: He legislated against opposition criticism and prohibited Protestant announcements.

religious-exemptions.rationale: He extended persecution to Jewish ritual slaughter through prohibition.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: He imposed German jurisdiction and compulsory nationality in annexed lands.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: His directives censored church announcements and restricted Catholic youth organizations.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: He consolidated party leadership and the chief-of-state office.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: He retrospectively legalized the 1934 murders as Hitler’s exercise of supreme judicial authority.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: His administration incorporated the Sudetenland and other claimed German territories.

history-own-civilization.rationale: He prescribed nationally centered history lessons about war, Versailles and Nazi resurgence.

patriotic-education.rationale: He explicitly demanded schools foster national unity and devotion to the state.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: His civil-service law required racial exclusion from government employment.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: His centralizing legislation removed the constitutional safeguards of the previous order.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: His Enabling Act replaced parliamentary lawmaking with cabinet decrees.

religious-nation.rationale: He explained Aryan status through ancestry rather than religious belief.

defeat-communism.rationale: He initiated confiscation of Communist property and suppression of Communist organization.

suppress-opposition.rationale: He directed legislation abolishing parties and interning political dissidents.

racial-franchise.rationale: His implementing regulation expressly denied Jews voting and public office.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: A contemporary report identifies Frick as advocating exclusion of Jews from business and industry.

independent-unions.rationale: He legislated union suppression and transferred their property to the Labor Front.

second-chamber.rationale: He abolished the Reichsrat in centralizing the state.

person-over-state.rationale: His education program rejected serving individual development over the national state.

race-social-construct.rationale: He defended citizenship classifications through ancestry and purported racial blood distinctions.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: His 1937 speech presented support for Germans abroad as a Reich interest.

notes: Research covers his early police and parliamentary activities, Thuringian ministry, Reich Interior Ministry and wartime protectorate. Police responsibility must distinguish formal jurisdiction from Himmler’s practical independence, recognized by the final judgment. The prosecution compilation is used for identified speeches, laws and administrative acts, not as proof of every prosecutorial characterization. Diplomatic and scholarly reports of speeches are secondhand and receive at most medium confidence. No position on voluntary assisted dying is derived from involuntary Nazi killings. Modern technology and ecological questions remain null where no matching position was found. Auditor ID taken from the local Codex model configuration.
